contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
[IMP C VICTORIN](V)S P F AVG ; (V)[IRTVS AVG]

268-270AD. Roman, copper alloy, silver washed, Victorinus - The Usurper in the West, billon antoninianus. Length 17.1mm, Width 16.0mm, Thickness 1.7mm, Diameter 17.1mm, Weight 1.4g. Obverse: Draped, radiate bust right. Inscription: [IMP C VICTORIN](V)S P F AVG Reverse: Virtus - soldier standing right, resting on spear and holding shield. Inscription: (V)[IRTVS AVG]. Die Axis 330 deg. or 11 o'clock Some wear, especially the reverse, obverse details still visible. Small remnants of silvering but otherwise dark grey patina and rusty deposit on the surface probably due to wet, marshy ground conditions. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 58, Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece…
